"import os
import math
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

def draw_stickman(draw, center_x, center_y, frame):
    # Head
    head_radius = 50
    head_y = center_y - 150
    draw.ellipse(
        [(center_x - head_radius, head_y - head_radius), 
         (center_x + head_radius, head_y + head_radius)], 
        outline="white", width=5)
    
    # Body
    body_bottom = center_y + 100
    draw.line([(center_x, head_y + head_radius), (center_x, body_bottom)], fill="white", width=5)
    
    # Legs
    draw.line([(center_x, body_bottom), (center_x - 50, body_bottom + 100)], fill="white", width=5)
    draw.line([(center_x, body_bottom), (center_x + 50, body_bottom + 100)], fill="white", width=5)
    
    # Left Arm (Holding chalk or pointing)
    shoulder_y = head_y + head_radius + 20
    draw.line([(center_x, shoulder_y), (center_x - 80, shoulder_y + 40)], fill="white", width=5)
    
    # Right Arm (Scratching head)
    # Animation logic
    hand_x_base = center_x + head_radius + 10
    hand_y_base = head_y - 10
    
    elbow_x_base = center_x + 80
    elbow_y_base = shoulder_y + 10
    
    rest_hand_x = center_x + 80
    rest_hand_y = shoulder_y + 80
    rest_elbow_x = center_x + 50
    rest_elbow_y = shoulder_y + 40
    
    if frame < 15:
        progress = frame / 15.0
        hx = rest_hand_x + (hand_x_base - rest_hand_x) * progress
        hy = rest_hand_y + (hand_y_base - rest_hand_y) * progress
        ex = rest_elbow_x + (elbow_x_base - rest_elbow_x) * progress
        ey = rest_elbow_y + (elbow_y_base - rest_elbow_y) * progress
    elif frame < 45:
        # Scratching animation
        scratch_progress = (frame - 15) / 30.0
        offset_x = math.sin(scratch_progress * math.pi * 6) * 10
        offset_y = math.cos(scratch_progress * math.pi * 6) * 5
        hx = hand_x_base + offset_x
        hy = hand_y_base + offset_y
        ex = elbow_x_base
        ey = elbow_y_base
    else:
        progress = (frame - 45) / 14.0
